capabilities.decisionReason: Named deliberate loss: Tæt visuel feedbackloop. Live-loopet er ikke nødvendigt for SiteSmith v3's kerne og øger state-, security-, framework- og cross-platform-risiko væsentligt.
capabilities.requiredImprovement: Hvis behovet bevises: isoleret pluginproces, CSP, signed session protocol, framework-specific safe appliers, complete live-setup, Windows/Linux/macOS browser-E2E og recovery/fuzz tests.
capabilities.verificationMethod: Exact exclusion assertion: Live server, browser harness, SSE/poll protocol, token/session journal, variant loop, source applier, commands, assets, and runtime entry points are absent from SiteSmith core and package output.

clean-room-standard.matrixText: clean-room reimplementation — Implement natively; upstream remains a behavioural reference and copied expression remains provenance-tracked.

spec-compatible-standard.matrixText: spec-compatible reimplementation — Adapt semantics behind the module interface; do not concatenate prompts.

deliberate-rejection.matrixText: deliberate rejection — Exclude the source mechanism and record the named loss; the negative fixture proves exclusion only.

clean-room-brand-input.matrixText: clean-room reimplementation — Implement natively from the outcome contract; do not copy the raster-board implementation or prompt expression.

clean-room-style-lenses.matrixText: clean-room reimplementation — Implement natively from the outcome contract; do not copy sibling-persona, simulated-randomness, or prompt expression.

clean-room-run-checkpoints.matrixText: clean-room reimplementation — Implement natively from the outcome contract; do not copy urgency language, pause-marker protocol, research claims, or prompt expression.

vendored-deterministic.matrixText: vendored component — Pin the deterministic subset behind a typed adapter and verify its source hash.

clean-room-product-reasoning.matrixText: clean-room reimplementation — Implement natively from the outcome contract; do not copy classifier code, source data expression, top-one stereotype selection, or prompt expression.

principle-only.matrixText: principle-only inspiration — Preserve the documented prompt principle as a behaviour target; do not copy prompt expression or treat it as deterministic code or an adapter.

spec-compatible-retained.matrixText: spec-compatible reimplementation — Retain the semantic contract behind a typed SiteSmith artifact.

provider-plugin.matrixText: provider-plugin — Pin the deterministic subset behind a typed adapter and verify its source hash.

taste-mit.matrixText: MIT: retain Taste copyright and permission notice for copied or substantial portions; track asset and dependency rights separately.

uupm-mit.matrixText: MIT: retain the Next Level Builder copyright and permission notice for copied code, data, or substantial wording; pin provenance.

mixed-bundle.matrixText: Mixed bundle: retain root MIT plus every Apache-2.0/OFL/component notice; never flatten installed artifacts to root MIT.

frontend-apache.matrixText: Apache-2.0: ship the licence, retain applicable notices, and mark modified copied files; font licences remain separate.
